idea: Ask: “Anything you’re looking forward to this week—or glad is behind you?”
Ask: “Discovered any good eats lately—a café, snack, or recipe worth stealing?”
Ask: “How’s your commute treating you lately—same old or anything new?”
Ask: “What’s one small win you’ve had recently that nobody noticed but you?”
Ask: “Watching or reading anything good—worth recommending or happily forgetting?”
Ask: “Favorite thing about this time of year where you live?”
Ask: “If you had a free weekend with zero logistics, where would you drift?”
Ask: “Learning anything new lately—even tiny, like a keyboard shortcut or coffee tweak?”
Ask: “Any pets, plants, or hobbies quietly taking over your apartment?”
Ask: “What’s on repeat for you—song, podcast, or guilty playlist?”
Ask: “Anything changing in your neighborhood you’ve noticed—good or weird?”
Ask: “What’s your low-effort comfort ritual after a long day?”
Ask: “Met anyone interesting recently—or reconnected with someone out of the blue?”
Ask: “Best thing someone’s recommended to you in the last month?”
Bond lightly: “What’s your harmless pet peeve lately—like noisy keyboards or meetings that could’ve been an email?”
Ask: “Any spring plans kicking in—day trips, errands you’re pretending are adventures?”
